name: Store Locator – Google Maps – WC – Elementor – Fast loading – Local SEO
author: digitalplugs

sections.description:
Your customers are already on your website. Digital Plug Store Locator walks them straight through your door — and Google sends you new ones.

Digital Plug Store Locator is a high-performance, modern mapping solution that bridges the gap between your website and your physical business locations. Whether you run 5 stores or 5,000, your customers can find the nearest branch, get instant on-map directions, and filter locations by the services they need — without ever leaving your website.

Most store locator plugins just drop a map on a page — invisible to Google, worthless for SEO. This one is different: it’s a local marketing engine. Every store gets a real, indexable page with rich LocalBusiness schema (star ratings, opening hours, the exact business type), so your locations can show up in local search results with “Open now” and review stars — and drive organic foot traffic while you sleep.

And it’s fast: the entire frontend runs on a modern React engine (the same technology behind WordPress itself — zero extra libraries to load), so searching, filtering and browsing stores feels instant on every device.

🔗 Quick Links

  • 🎬 Live Interactive Demo
  • 📚 Step-by-Step Documentation
  • 🔑 How to Get a Google Maps API Key
  • 💎 See Everything PRO Unlocks

⚡ WHAT YOU GET FOR FREE

  • 📍 On-Map Instant Directions — Turn-by-turn routing from the visitor’s location, right on your map. Customers never get redirected away from your site.
  • 🎯 Smart “Near Me” Detection — One click and the closest branches surface instantly.
  • 🏷️ Unlimited Store Attributes — Tag stores with anything: “WiFi”, “Wheelchair Accessible”, “Drive-Thru”, “Click & Collect”…
  • 🔍 Flexible Frontend Filters — Visitors narrow stores down to exactly what they need.
  • 🗺️ Map & Satellite Views — Standard roadmap or high-resolution satellite, one toggle away.
  • 🎨 Custom Styles & 10 Built-in Map Themes — Paste your own JSON map style or pick a beautiful preset.
  • 📌 Unique Map Markers — A global brand pin, or a unique icon per store.
  • 🔄 Instant CSV Import & Export — Populate or back up thousands of locations in seconds.
  • 📧 Direct Manager Contacts — Customers message a specific branch; you read it in your dashboard.
  • 📊 Built-in Search Analytics — See what and where your visitors search.
  • 🌍 Global Multi-Lingual Support — Pre-translated for Arabic 🇸🇦, Chinese 🇨🇳, French 🇫🇷, German 🇩🇪, Hindi 🇮🇳, Japanese 🇯🇵, Russian 🇷🇺, Spanish 🇪🇸, and more.
  • ⚛️ Modern React Frontend — The locator renders on WordPress’s own React engine: instant search-as-you-type, zero page reloads, silky-smooth filtering. No build tools, no bloated bundles — one switch turns it on, and you can return to the classic frontend any time.
  • 🚀 Real Local SEO, Free — Not just a map: every store gets rich LocalBusiness schema with the exact business type (Restaurant, Pharmacy, ClothingStore…), live opening hours (“Open now” in Google), review stars from your own customers, images, and breadcrumbs — plus templated SEO titles & meta descriptions like {store_name} in {city} | {site_name}. Pass Google’s Rich Results Test out of the box.

💎 GO PRO — BUILT TO SELL MORE, NOT JUST SHOW MORE

The free version finds your stores. PRO turns your store locator into a sales machine — and a Local SEO engine that brings customers in from Google.

⭐ PRO HIGHLIGHTS: AUTOMATED LOCAL SEO LANDING PAGES · 4 PREMIUM TEMPLATES · FRONTEND STORE SUBMISSION · ENGAGEMENT ANALYTICS · 1-CLICK FULL-SITE IMPORT/EXPORT ⭐

Here is exactly what upgrading unlocks:

🚀 The Local SEO Engine — Rank in Every City You Operate In

  • 🏙️ Automated City Landing Pages — PRO instantly generates a beautiful, indexable landing page for every city you have stores in (/locations/new-york/, /locations/london/…), complete with store cards, templated intro text, CollectionPage schema and XML sitemap entries. Open a store in a new city — its ranking page exists the same second. Zero writing, zero setup, pure organic traffic.
  • 🔗 Automatic Internal-Link Silo — Every store page links to its nearest locations and up to its city page. This is the interlinking structure SEO agencies charge thousands to build — done for you, automatically.
  • ✍️ Per-Store SEO Control — A dedicated SEO box on every store: custom title, meta description, schema business type, price range, and social profile links (sameAs) that connect your Google Business Profile, Facebook and Instagram to each location.
  • 📊 Engagement Analytics That Prove ROI — See exactly what your locator earns you: page views, click-to-call, get-directions and website clicks per store, plus contact messages — in one clean dashboard. Privacy-friendly (daily totals only, no cookies, no visitor tracking), so it’s GDPR-safe by design.

🎨 Design That Makes Visitors Stay

  • 🖼️ 4 Stunning Premium Templates — Swap the standard locator for magazine-quality designs (“Nordic”, “Spatial Hub”, and the new “Property Finder” for real-estate & apartment listings) with hover info cards, smart top-bar filters, distance sliders, gallery popups and animated map pins.
  • 🌈 8 Curated Color Themes Per Template — Dark, Mediterranean Blue, Sage & Olive, Royal Emerald, Terracotta, Monochrome, Nordic, Midnight. One click recolors everything to match your brand.
  • 🖥️ 4 Single-Store Page Layouts — Every branch gets its own gorgeous, conversion-optimized landing page.
  • 📐 Frontend View Switcher — Let visitors flip between Split, List, Grid and Map views themselves.
  • 🔗 Social Media Icons — Add unlimited Facebook, Instagram, X/Twitter or any Font Awesome icon to each store, each with its own link. Customize the icon color and label once and they appear automatically on the store card, the single store page, and all 4 premium templates.

🛒 Deep WooCommerce Integration

  • 📦 Per-Store Product Inventory — A simple stock grid: which product is available in which store. Customers see it before they travel.
  • 🔎 “Find in Stores” Button — On every product page: shoppers click and instantly see the branches that stock that exact product.
  • 🧲 Product Filter on the Locator — Visitors pick a product and the map shows only the stores that have it.
  • 🛍️ In-Card Product Popups — Hover a store, click its products button and browse that store’s in-stock items with photos and prices.

⏰ Real-Time Store Intelligence

  • 🟢 Live “OPEN NOW” Badges — Per-day hours, split shifts, classic “Mon–Fri 9–6” or 24/7 — the badge updates itself in real time.
  • 🏆 “Nearest” Store Badges — Automatically highlight the closest branches to every visitor.
  • ⭐ Moderated Ratings & Reviews — Build trust with star ratings. You approve every review before it goes live.

🌍 Let Your Users Do The Work

  • 📝 Frontend Store Submission — Vendors, agents and customers add their own stores from a beautiful frontend form: address with live map pin, photos, gallery, business hours, attributes and more. You control who can submit (by user role) and approve every store before it goes live — perfect for directories, real-estate portals and multi-vendor sites.

🚀 Time-Saving Power Tools

  • ⚡ Advanced One-Click Import/Export — Export your ENTIRE setup (stores, settings, categories, attributes, ratings, stock) into a single file and restore it anywhere with a live progress bar. Migrations and demo setups in minutes, like a premium theme.
  • 📸 Immersive Store Galleries — Multi-photo lightbox galleries with captions for every location.
  • 🤖 Address Auto-Detection & Click-to-Pin — Start typing an address and coordinates fill themselves, or just click the map to drop the pin.
  • 🧩 Drag-and-Drop Elementor Widgets — Dedicated Search, Map and Store List widgets. Design any layout, zero code.

🤝 White-Glove Treatment

  • 🆓 Free Installation — Our engineers set PRO up for you, free.
  • 🕜 24/7 Priority Support — Real developers, around the clock.

👉 Upgrade to PRO now and turn your locator into your best salesperson →

🛠️ Need Help or Custom Development?

Looking for a specific feature or a fully tailored solution? Email help@digital-plugs.com and you’ll be connected directly with a senior WordPress, PHP, and JavaScript engineer.

External Services

This plugin integrates with and sends data to Google Maps APIs (specifically the Maps JavaScript API, Geocoding API, and Places API) to render the interactive map search, fetch location coordinates, and display autocompleted addresses.
* Data Transmitted: User input addresses, coordinates (latitude/longitude), and your Google Maps API Key are safely transmitted to Google’s servers.
* Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy https://policies.google.com/privacy
* Terms of Service: Google Maps Platform Terms of Service https://cloud.google.com/maps-platform/terms

Shortcode Usage

Insert the core shortcode into any page, post, or widget area:
[dpsl_store_locator]

Advanced Layout Customization (Parameters):

  • [dpsl_store_locator show_map="true" show_search="true" show_filter="true" per_page="20"]

💎 PRO Template Shortcodes:

  • [dpsl_stores_template template="3"] — render Premium Template 1, 2 or 3.
  • [dpsl_stores_template template="5"] — render the Property Finder template (real-estate style listing with radius search, sorting, gallery popups and print view).
  • [dpsl_stores_template template="3" store_category="fashion"] — a premium template showing only one store category.
  • [dpsl_store_submit] — the Frontend Store Submission form, so users can add their own stores (role-restricted, with admin approval).
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Digital Plug Store Locator – Google Maps for WooCommerce & Elementor, or upload the .zip file downloaded from the repository.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Navigate to the new Store Locator > Settings tab to configure your Google Maps API Key.
  5. Create custom store traits under Store Locator > Attributes.
  6. Add your very first physical storefront under Store Locator > Add New Store.
  7. Place the [dpsl_store_locator] shortcode on any target page.
sections.faq:
Why does my map show a “For Development Purposes Only” message?

This is a standard message from Google when your Google Maps API Key is either missing, typed incorrectly, or does not have an active billing account linked to it. Google gives you a generous free tier every single month, but they require a payment method on file to authenticate queries. Follow our API Key Setup Guide Here.

Does this plugin actually help my stores rank on Google?

Yes — and this is where we differ from every “map widget” plugin. The free version outputs complete LocalBusiness schema per store (business type, opening hours, review stars, images) plus templated SEO titles and descriptions, so each location page is genuinely rankable. The 💎 PRO version goes further: it auto-generates an indexable landing page for every city you operate in, interlinks all your locations, adds per-store SEO controls — and then proves the results with a per-store dashboard of calls, direction requests and website clicks. That’s an automated local marketing machine, not just a map.

Will the React frontend conflict with my theme?

No. It uses the React copy that ships inside WordPress core itself (no extra libraries, no build step) and renders the exact same design as the classic frontend. It’s a single toggle in Settings — and switching it off instantly restores the classic frontend, so there’s zero risk in trying it.

Can I show which products are available in which store?

Yes! This is the flagship feature of the 💎 PRO version. You get a per-store stock grid, a “Find in Stores” button on product pages, a product filter on the locator, and in-card product popups — so shoppers always know where to buy before they leave home.

Can I use Elementor to design my location listings?

Yes, Elementor compatibility is a core feature of the 💎 PRO version. It installs modular widgets (search boxes, filters, maps, and store lists) allowing you to design your layout with absolute pixel-perfect freedom.

Can I change how the store locator looks without coding?

Absolutely. The free version includes color controls and 10 map themes. The 💎 PRO version adds 4 complete premium page templates, each with 8 one-click color themes plus a fully custom color palette builder — the entire locator restyles itself instantly.

Can I move my whole setup to another website?

With the 💎 PRO version, yes — in one click. Advanced Export packs every store, setting, category, attribute, rating and stock record into one file; Advanced Import restores it anywhere with a live progress bar. (Your Google API key is never exported, for your security.)

How can I translate the plugin text?

The plugin is entirely localized and translation-ready right out of the box. You can easily use tools like Loco Translate, Poedit, or WPML to adapt text domains to your language preferences.
